ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Child Care Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial trail of child care fraud in Minnesota, including the sources of funding and the individuals and organizations involved.
questions: What are the sources of funding for child care programs in Minnesota?
Who are the key individuals and organizations involved in the fraud scheme?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant financial wrongdoing and shed light on the scope of the child care fraud problem in Minnesota.
